verdict.rationale: dLocal documents outbound HTTP notifications sent to a merchant-specified notification URL for every payment status change [dlocal-docs-17]. These carry a signature that can be verified for integrity [dlocal-docs-18], and the Sandbox can trigger webhooks for testing [dlocal-docs-6]. That covers the core of programmatic event subscription. Missing for 10: an event-type catalog or selective subscription per event, a documented retry/delivery policy, webhook coverage beyond payment status (e.g. payouts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
